ja259:1.1: There is nothing done with wisdom in him,
ja259:1.2: He is not your kin or companion,
ja259:1.4: The one with three sticks, eat the choicest food?
ja259:2.1: In distress, being defeated in war,
ja259:2.2: Being alone in an awful desert,
ja259:2.3: He stretched out his hand when I was troubled,
ja259:2.4: By that I escaped torment and suffering.
ja259:3.1: By him doing his duty I reached here,
ja259:3.2: From death’s realm to the world of the living,
ja259:3.3: Tirīṭavaccha, dear, is worthy to receive,
ja259:3.4: Give him wealth, offer him an offering.
